note: A structured record of what the contract says, one field per term, each with the passage it comes from and the exact words (and, for a term a redline replaces, the whole sentence). Hand-written, standing in for an extraction step; a test checks every quote and clause against the contract text.

parties.quote: between Acme Cloud, Inc., a Delaware corporation

productScope.value: Acme Observability: hosted logs, metrics and traces
productScope.quote: its hosted observability platform, Acme Observability

initialTermMonths.quote: thirty-six (36) months from the Effective Date

renewalTermMonths.quote: renews automatically for successive thirty-six (36) month terms
renewalTermMonths.clause: Each Order Form renews automatically for successive thirty-six (36) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

renewalNoticeDays.quote: at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term

paymentDays.quote: within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date
paymentDays.clause: Northstar will pay each undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date.

liabilityCapMonths.quote: the fees paid by Northstar in the three (3) months before the event giving rise to the claim
liabilityCapMonths.clause: Each party's total liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Northstar in the three (3) months before the event giving rise to the claim.

ipIndemnity.quote: Acme will defend Northstar against any third-party claim that the Services infringe

processesCustomerPersonalData.quote: may include personal data about Northstar's customers

dataProcessingAddendum.quote: Acme will process Customer Data to provide and support the Services and as otherwise permitted by this Agreement
dataProcessingAddendum.clause: Acme will process Customer Data to provide and support the Services and as otherwise permitted by this Agreement.

breachNoticeHours.clause: If Acme confirms that an unauthorized person has accessed Customer Data (a "Security Incident"), Acme will notify Northstar within ten (10) days and will share what it knows about the cause, the data affected and the steps it is taking.

securityProgram.value: written program, encryption, yearly questionnaire; no audit reports

usageData.quote: Acme owns all usage data and derived insights
usageData.clause: Acme owns all usage data and derived insights generated from the operation of the Services, including information derived from Customer Data, and may use them for any purpose during and after the term.

confidentialityYearsAfter.quote: for five (5) years after it ends

terminationForConvenienceDays.quote: Neither party may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience
terminationForConvenienceDays.clause: Neither party may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience before the end of the then-current term, and fees for the full term remain payable.

assignment.quote: except to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets

insurance.quote: cyber liability insurance of at least $5,000,000 per claim

governingLaw.quote: governed by the laws of the State of California
